$comment: Hijri Shamsi conversion, checked by the Kotlin implementation in
mobile/core/i18n and the TypeScript one in admin/src/i18n, so the driver's
app and the operator's panel cannot start disagreeing about what day it is.
A driver who phones support quoting a date must be quoting the date the
nowruz is the load-bearing table: 1 Hamal as actually observed, and the
only authority in this file. A leap rule is accepted or rejected by these
dates, never the other way round. The 2820-year (Birashk) rule is rejected
by them: it misplaces Nowruz 1404 by a day, which silently shifted every
1374-1378 are here on purpose. They are the years that tell a correct
residue set from one off by a single number; the 1398-1405 rows all fall in
one stretch of the cycle and pass either way.
Outside these years the 33-year cycle is an arithmetic approximation of an
astronomical calendar. Check an almanac before trusting a far-off date on a
